dedupe_keys.name: dataset article simplified ejector booster systems

description: A. Álvarez Pardiñas at SINTEF Energi publishes experimental results for ejector-supported R744 booster refrigeration systems. The 2022 Zenodo deposit contains seven workbooks for different system configurations and evaporation temperatures, plus a variable dictionary, free under CC BY 4.0. Each workbook has average results and uncertainty estimates with coverage factor two; rows represent test conditions. Documented columns include temperature, pressure, refrigerant and glycol flow, compressor power, cooling load and coefficient of performance. These measurements can calibrate cold-chain equipment simulations or compare electricity demand under refrigeration-control choices. Coverage is a laboratory system, not monitored supermarkets, and the metadata do not establish test dates or geographic transferability. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these experiments. The dictionary was read, including its units and uncertainty convention, but numerical workbooks and reported efficiency improvements were not independently checked.
